name: modern-selfdrive
description: Modern Selfdrive Car — Full-stack car rental platform (Vercel + Render)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,public,portal -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:public" "npm run dev:portal"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../apps/public && npm install && cd ../portal && npm install
scripts.lint:all: concurrently "cd server && npm run lint" "cd apps/public && npm run lint" "cd apps/portal && npm run lint"
